subject: [RFC PATCH 3/5] mm/page_alloc: convert any movable pageblock on a non-movable allocation

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner
reviews.summary: Identified potential fragmentation issue where unmovable blocks might explode due to short-lived allocations, suggesting proactive eviction of movable constituents.

reviews.author: Rik van Riel
reviews.summary: Offered to resend the patch as a larger series addressing fragmentation and 2MB granularity issues, but awaiting author's preference.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: Proposal to convert movable pageblocks on non-movable allocations, raising concerns about fragmentation and unmovable block explosion.
